title: Career Roadmap: Research Assistant
summary: Support psychological and neuroscience research by reviewing scientific literature, recruiting participants, collecting and analysing data, assisting with experiments and maintaining accurate research records under the supervision of a research investigator.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Psychology & Neuroscience

blocks.text: Support psychological and neuroscience research by reviewing scientific literature, recruiting participants, collecting and analysing data, assisting with experiments and maintaining accurate research records under the supervision of a research investigator.

rows.text: Any stream; Biology, Psychology, Mathematics and Statistics are useful
Liberal Arts degree majoring in Psychology, Neuroscience or Cognitive Science
Cognitive psychology, behavioural science, clinical research, developmental psychology or neuroscience
M.A./M.Sc. Psychology, Cognitive Science, Neuroscience or a related research discipline

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Research roles differ in their requirements. Some accept bachelor's graduates, while advanced laboratory, clinical or specialist research positions may require postgraduate qualifications or specific training.

blocks.label: Research Methods
blocks.text: Experimental design, hypothesis testing and literature reviews.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Excel, statistics, SPSS, R or Python.

blocks.label: Participant Management
blocks.text: Recruitment, scheduling, informed consent and research communication.

blocks.label: Research Ethics
blocks.text: Confidentiality, participant safety, ethical approvals and responsible data handling.

blocks.label: Scientific Writing
blocks.text: Research summaries, reports, citations and presentations.

blocks.label: Technical Skills
blocks.text: Survey tools, behavioural experiment software or laboratory methods, depending on the research area.
Develop three or four supervised or ethically designed projects:

blocks.label: Literature Review
blocks.text: Summarize evidence on memory, attention, cognition or behaviour.

blocks.label: Survey Research
blocks.text: Design a questionnaire and analyse appropriately collected, consented data.

blocks.label: Behavioural Experiment
blocks.text: Develop a simple study protocol under suitable supervision and ethical approval.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Analyse a public or simulated dataset using statistical software.

blocks.label: Research Poster
blocks.text: Present a research question, methods, findings, limitations and references.
Do not collect sensitive participant data or conduct human-subject research without the necessary ethical oversight and consent.
Target placements at:

items.text: Cognitive science and behavioural research laboratories.
Public health and social science research institutes.
Human-computer interaction and behavioural research teams.
Research-focused NGOs and clinical research organisations, where eligible.

blocks.text: Look for Research Intern, Psychology Research Assistant, Behavioural Research Intern and Cognitive Science Intern roles.
Prioritize:

items.text: SPSS, R or Python for data analysis.

blocks.text: For neuroscience projects, learn relevant experimental software or laboratory techniques when required by the research group.
Undergraduate Research Intern
Research Assistant
Senior Research Assistant / Research Coordinator
PhD Researcher → Research Scientist / Academic
Progression into independent research or academic positions typically requires advanced qualifications and demonstrated research capability.

items.text: Junior Data Analyst in a research team
Behavioural science and user research teams
Clinical research organisations, subject to eligibility
Social science research institutions and NGOs

rows.text: Select a research area, read foundational papers and learn research ethics and basic statistics.
Complete a literature review and practise analysing a public or simulated dataset.
Prepare an academic CV, research summary and portfolio; contact suitable research groups and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Research-methods knowledge, statistical literacy, ethical research practices, clear scientific writing and practical experience with data collection or analysis.
